def solve_batch(study):
    from itertools import combinations
    tr = study['train']
    x = np.asarray(tr['x'])
    xt = np.asarray(study['test']['x'])
    n = len(x)
    z = (np.vstack([x, xt]) - x.mean(0)) / np.maximum(x.std(0), 1e-12)
    q = -np.expm1(-np.asarray(study['eval_times'])[:, None] * np.array([0.392, 1.857]))
    a = np.linalg.lstsq(q, tr['traj'].T, rcond=None)[0].T
    (s, g) = _features(z)
    f = np.column_stack(s + g + [np.prod(z[:, j], axis=1) for j in combinations(range(4), 3)])[:, 1:]
    ys = (2, 5, 10, 14, 16, 23, 24, 26, 33, 35, 40, 50, 51, 52, 54, 61, 63, 64, 65, 67, 77, 78, 85, 87, 92, 93, 96, 101, 102, 104, 106, 111, 119, 128, 132, 137)
    fs = (7, 9, 10, 24, 30, 31, 35, 36, 39, 40, 51, 54, 61, 68, 71, 72, 85, 86, 96, 101, 104, 106, 111, 112, 123, 127, 128, 134)

    def ols(ids, y):
        mat = np.column_stack([np.ones(len(z)), f[:, ids]])
        return mat[n:] @ np.linalg.lstsq(mat[:n], y, rcond=None)[0]
    m = np.column_stack(s + [g[j] for j in (0, 1, 3)])
    m = m / np.maximum(np.linalg.norm(m[:n], axis=0), 1e-08)
    slow = m[n:] @ m[:n].T @ np.linalg.solve(m[:n] @ m[:n].T + 0.02 * np.eye(n), a[:, 0])
    y = ols(ys, tr['y'])
    pred = np.column_stack([slow, ols(fs, a[:, 1])]) @ q.T
    return {'y_hat': y, 'state_pred': pred, 'diagnostics_vec': np.array([y.mean(), y.std(), pred[:, -1].mean(), pred[:, -1].std()])}

def _panel_pred(study, blend, reg, kind):
    tr = study['train']
    n = len(tr['x'])
    xx = np.vstack([tr['x'], study['test']['x']])
    p = study['panel_a']
    u = np.asarray(p['u'])
    v = np.asarray(p['v'])
    h = np.column_stack([np.ones(len(u)), u])
    av = np.linalg.lstsq(h, v, rcond=None)[0]
    r = np.linalg.norm(v - h @ av, axis=1)
    keep = r < 3
    gains = []
    offsets = []
    for j in range(4):
        c = np.linalg.lstsq(h[keep][:, [0, j + 1]], v[keep, j], rcond=None)[0]
        offsets.append(c[0])
        gains.append(c[1])
    z = (xx - offsets) / gains
    if kind == 'sat':
        p = study['panel_c']
        u = np.asarray(p['u'])
        v = np.asarray(p['v2'])
        h = np.column_stack([np.ones(len(u)), u])
        b = np.linalg.lstsq(h, v, rcond=None)[0]
        pz = np.column_stack([np.ones(len(u)), u, np.expm1(-0.2962 * u * u)])
        w = np.linalg.lstsq(pz, v, rcond=None)[0]
        v = np.column_stack([np.ones(len(z)), z, np.expm1(-0.2962 * z * z)]) @ w
        z = z + blend * ((v - np.column_stack([np.ones(len(z)), z]) @ b) @ np.linalg.inv(b[1:]))
        t = np.tanh(z)
    else:
        z = z + blend * np.expm1(-0.2962 * z * z)
        t = None

    def quad(a):
        return [a] + [a[:, i] * a[:, j] for i in range(4) for j in range(i, 4)]
    f = np.column_stack(quad(z) + (quad(t) if t is not None else [np.sin(z), np.cos(z), np.sin(2 * z), np.cos(2 * z)]))
    f = (f - f[:n].mean(0)) / np.maximum(f[:n].std(0), 1e-07)
    y = np.column_stack([tr['y'], tr['traj']])
    ym = y.mean(0)
    return f[n:] @ f[:n].T @ np.linalg.solve(f[:n] @ f[:n].T + reg * np.eye(n), y - ym) + ym
